scope: Draft architecture, lifecycle, attendance, refund policy. Mock-only localStorage Next.js 16 MVP, no backend.

details.reason: Fix requires a Next.js major downgrade. Build-time CSS tooling, not an app runtime input path. Carried over from CS6/CS7.

findings.observation: Drafts (ShiftDraft) are employer-scoped (forEmployer filters by employerId) and never enter the public shift listing (domain/filter requires Published/FullyBooked + Deposited). A worker's job list cannot show a draft.
findings.test: e2e/22-core-stability-8.spec.ts (worker job list never shows a draft); coreStability8.test.ts (forEmployer scoping)

findings.observation: The draft list is read via forEmployer(currentUserId) and the new-shift page only restores drafts owned by the authenticated employer; there is no cross-employer draft surface. A lingering Draft shift can only be discarded by discardDraftShift, which acts on the store the authenticated employer controls.

Worker cannot trigger employer attendance actions and vice-versa: mark-present/absent/revert live on the employer's own RoleGuard'd shift detail (shift.employerId === currentUserId, 404 on mismatch); worker self check-in/out act on the worker's own application. Employer mark-present no longer sets the worker's checkInAt, so it cannot impersonate a worker self check-in.

Wallet refunds are issued only by lifecycle/system code paths (empty-expiry, completion unused-slot, RequireFull auto-cancel) or admin dispute resolution — never by a worker/guest request. The deposit guard + contact guard run in simulateDeposit before any mutation, so a direct/programmatic publish cannot bypass them.
findings.test: coreStability8.test.ts (simulateDeposit guards; refund only via lifecycle)

findings.observation: discardDraftShift refuses non-Draft shifts (a Published shift must go through cancel). simulateDeposit enforces past-shift, verification, contact, and balance guards in-store. A direct call cannot publish without funds/contact or silently delete a published shift.
findings.test: coreStability8.test.ts (discardDraftShift refuses Published; contact + balance guards)

findings.observation: Refund / expiry / auto-cancel notifications are filtered by recipient userId and deeplink only to the recipient's own dashboard wallet modal or shift detail; they never expose another user's data.
Draft fields (title, description, notes, contact) are rendered as escaped React text in the 'Bản nháp đã lưu' list; numeric phone is digit-sanitized on input. No draft field is rendered as HTML.

knownLimitations: Mock-only: all authorization is client-side; a user can edit localStorage via devtools. Real server-side authz is the Phase 1 backend deliverable (backend-migration-plan.md).
Clearing browser storage loses all runtime data (documented in backend-readiness-plan.md §2).
